facts: OMP 18.4.4 does NOT enable mouse tracking (startup DECSETs observed by Root: ?1l ?2004h ?2026h ?2031h ?25h ?5522h ?7h), so OMP panes and a plain host shell receive no mouse; apps like vim with mouse=a do.

The user's tmux has set -s set-clipboard on and allow-passthrough on; tmux default is set-clipboard external (app OSC 52 ignored). herdr 0.9.2 (ghostty_vt) captures pane OSC 52 and forwards it to its client. The user runs Mac cmux -> ssh -> herdr or tmux -> wb.
required_behavior: In a pane that does not track the mouse (no 1000/1002/1003 from the pane app): left press inside the pane content starts a selection; motion extends it (clamped to that pane only, never crossing into other panes or borders); release copies. A click without movement keeps today's behaviour (focus). Divider drags, wheel, click-to-focus and forwarding to mouse-tracking panes stay as they are.

Selection is anchored in pane content coordinates that include the scrollback view: the user can scroll (wheel/Shift+PgUp) and select past output; dragging above the top / below the bottom inner edge auto-scrolls that pane's history while extending the selection.
Highlight the selected cells (reverse video) while dragging and after the copy until the next key, click, new selection, focus change or pane content reset.

Text extraction: rows in order, wide characters once, trailing spaces trimmed per row, rows joined with \n; a selection inside one row is a substring; cap at 1 MiB of UTF-8 (larger: copy refused with a notice).

Copy via OSC 52 written to the UI's own stdout: ESC ] 52 ; c ; <base64> BEL. When the UI runs inside tmux (TMUX env set) also write the same OSC 52 wrapped for tmux passthrough (ESC P tmux; ... ESC \ with inner ESC doubled) so it works with set-clipboard on or allow-passthrough on. Never execute tmux or any clipboard program. Footer notice e.g. '복사됨: 123자 (tmux는 set-clipboard on 또는 allow-passthrough on 필요)' - keep the tmux hint only when TMUX is set.
Output path: model queues the bytes, app.py loop writes them (like the mouse re-assert); nothing is written while the terminal is being restored.
Help overlay: one short line about drag-to-copy; keep HELP_LINES count <= current + 1.
acceptance: red->green tests in tests/ui/test_product_model.py: selection in each pane type, clamping, no cross-pane, auto-scroll, scrolled-back selection, wide chars, trailing trim, single-row substring, click-without-move = focus, tracking pane still gets mouse, cap, OSC 52 bytes exact incl. tmux wrapper only with TMUX
one PTY test in tests/ui/test_product_pty.py: real loop, SGR drag in the host pane after printing known text -> OSC 52 with the expected base64 on the UI stdout
